revisionPolicy: Version derives from the normalized corpus file inventory; the archive hash identifies the imported input, not an independently audited origin.

license.declared: Not established for imported playbook content
license.scope: The repository MIT license applies to package source code only and does not grant rights to imported playbook files.
license.thirdPartyReview: Entries state they compile public material (NVD / vendor advisories / public analyses); authorship, upstream revisions, and reuse or redistribution permissions have not been independently verified per entry.

audit.excludedReason: Only the offline playbook corpus was imported. The prompt-replacement configuration carries refusal-suppression and advertising instructions and is excluded outright; executable plugin code was reviewed but is reimplemented natively here rather than shipped.
audit.contentPolicy: All callback endpoints in playbook text are documentation placeholders (attacker/dnslog.cn). No injection directives targeting the model were found in the corpus.
audit.textPolicy: Normalized CRLF to LF, stripped UTF-8 BOM, preserved UTF-8 content otherwise.
audit.executionPolicy: Corpus files are data; the package never evaluates, downloads, or executes their content.
